title: Rabbi Abbahu bar Kahana
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Menachot 95b; and he is likewise mentioned in Shir HaShirim Rabbah ch. 4 and in Midrash Tehillim 106. But Hyman says that, without doubt, the correct reading should be Rabbi Abba bar Kahana, as cited in Midrash Tehillim (Buber edition), ch. 106, sec. 4.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The emphatic correction from Abbahu to Abba is Hyman’s own judgment, citing the Buber edition.

The consulted Menachot 95b and Shir HaShirim Rabbah chapter 4 passages support Abbahu bar Kahana. The consulted Buber Midrash Tehillim 106:4 paragraph contains both Abbahu bar Rabbi Kahana and Abba bar Kahana. Hyman’s emphatic “without doubt” correction is preserved as his judgment; the coexistence of both forms in this digital paragraph is not proof of an emendation or identity.
